note: The autonomy level and the bar for L3 (npm run autonomy; docs/AUTONOMY.md). A person, a Producer or Director session or an outside agent (on the owner's word) sets the level; never a worker. The scorecard only ever SUGGESTS a move: promotion when every L3 bar held for the window, demotion when the studio is at L3 and a bar fails. Rates are fractions (0.8 = 80%).
